Pálcás téglalap (03 §3.1 B)

Abbreviations (US terms)
ch – chain
dc – double crochet
st(s) – stitch(es)

Stitch key (US terms)
chain (ch)
double crochet (dc)

Pálcás téglalap
Row 1 – foundation: ch 19.
Row 2: skip 3 ch, dc in each ch across (16 sts). Turn.
Rows 3–16: ch 3 (turning chain), 16 dc (16 sts). Turn.
Row 17: ch 3 (turning chain), 16 dc (16 sts). Fasten off.
